heroSummary: Weber students began Tuesday, August 19, 2025, on an early-out schedule and continued early out through Friday of opening week. Every instructional Wednesday used a 12:20 elementary and 1:20 secondary dismissal, while secondary students followed the printed A/B rotation. The four quarters totaled 180 days, and the final day was Friday, May 22, 2026, with early out.
calendarNotes: Weber scheduled teacher contract days August 13–14 and professional development August 15 and 18 before students began August 19. August 19–22 were early-out days, and every instructional Wednesday was also early out at 12:20 for elementary and 1:20 for secondary students. The daily A/B letters in the grid identify the secondary rotation and do not represent closures. Elementary parent-teacher conferences were October 13–14 and February 4–5 with date-specific early-out instructions, while secondary conferences were September 24 and February 25. Compensation days November 26, January 2, and April 6 kept students out, with the April date extending Spring Break by one weekday. The quarter counts were 47, 44, 49, and 40 days for a published total of 180. The last day, May 22, was early out and also ended the fourth quarter.

customSections.label: Wednesday Early Out and the A/B Rotation
customSections.content: Every instructional Wednesday was early out at 12:20 for elementary and 1:20 for secondary students. The district also used early out August 19–22, December 19, March 20, and May 22. A/B letters belong to the secondary class rotation, so neither the weekly rule nor the daily letters are expanded into hundreds of calendar-import events.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Weber School District start in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Students began Tuesday, August 19, 2025. August 19–22 all used early-out schedules.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Weber Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break was March 30–April 3, 2026. A compensation day on Monday, April 6 extended the student closure through that date.

calendarFaqs.q: What time was Wednesday early out in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar lists 12:20 for elementary schools and 1:20 for secondary schools on every instructional Wednesday.

calendarFaqs.q: How many school days were in Weber's 2025–26 calendar?
